title: Pisces — Cosmic Tides Whisper Danger
script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury is forming a powerful square to Neptune, your dreamy ruler, scattering confusion across your 3rd House of Communication while your 12th House of Subconscious yearning feels intensified. Meanwhile, Jupiter sextiles Pluto in your 8th House of Transformation, turning financial opportunities into deep, soul‑nourishing revelations. In love, the Mercurian fog may blur sincerity, so trust your gut and speak plainly; singles will attract a mysterious water sign, while those coupled must avoid silent resentments. Career-wise, your 10th House of Public Image enjoys a supportive trine from Venus, blessing you with smooth collaborations and a sudden windfall from a creative venture. Beware of impulsive digital oversharing—this could sabotage credibility—but a hidden mentor may grant you an unexpected artistic breakthrough. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you stay ahead of the cosmic currents.
